summary: Online research reinforced that local/offline snapshots require explicit materialization and that safetensors structural parsing must be complemented by byte digest proof; baseline pressure remains exact SDPA/FlashAttention and KV-cache serving systems.

sources.fact: snapshot_download can materialize repository snapshots at revisions and to local cache/folders.
Transformers offline use depends on cached/downloaded files and local/offline controls.
Safetensors metadata can be parsed cheaply from headers; this is structure, not byte authenticity.
Transformers exposes multiple attention backends including eager, SDPA, FlashAttention variants, and flex attention.
PyTorch SDPA can route to optimized CUDA kernels.
FlashAttention is exact attention optimized around IO/memory movement.
PagedAttention/vLLM targets KV-cache memory waste and serving throughput.

decision: make_model_safetensors_digest_proof_promotion_required; keep eager trace separate from optimized timing baselines
